title: Implement complete-record row reversal from encoded elementary descriptors with a fixed finite tape program
body:
## Exact scoped result
A 524-location, 13-tape program reverses whole records from encoded P,R,B and returns the same owner, with an exact instruction count and retained-history bound. Independent runtime/proof checks passed. Caller descriptors remain a separate premise. Credits #5188.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/7662d01d827c95d90032579c168cae78aa531f2f/research/literal-row-reversal
